grammar: FURNACE 8-9 as amended A1-A2/F7-F8: authored numeral_fill (heat arc 15-45%) + authored bars vocabulary; no parity, no arithmetic

acceptance.contract: Design quality judged from rendered screenshots. No modulo/hash tinting, no repeated rail pseudo-elements, no gradient-with-label illustrations. Chapter art must never obscure prose.
acceptance.schema: READER-CONTRACT v1.0 §4; supervisor merges chapters{} into design/chapters.json sequentially

p2c1.caption: STA T-I · 3,794 words · FIG DRILL
p2c1.title: Chapter I
p2c1.contentRationale: Roark as anonymous drill-hand in a granite quarry; first hostile exchange with Dominique, who watches the red strand of hair sway with the drill. Motif: drill + radiating stone ledges.
p2c1.openerComposition: FURNACE banner slab #t2-c1 (FIG DRILL vignette, numeral fill 15%, bars DRILL) + chainage stamp + Oswald meta + ember-deep drop-cap
p2c1.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark
p2c1.notes: FIG DRILL [0] 'his knees, his wrists, his shoulders and the drill he held' (8 hits). Quarry drill-hand; first hostile exchange w/ Dominique [70]. DRILL bars = quarry steel, vertical. Fill 15% = Part-2 arc floor. Num 190px.

p2c10.caption: STA T-X · 6,246 words · FIG ENRIGHT-HOUSE
p2c10.title: Chapter X
p2c10.contentRationale: The Enright House opening, the boy photographer's stolen portrait of Roark, and Toohey's fenced, secret Temple commission to Stoddard. Motif: raised-arms tower + fence boards.
p2c10.openerComposition: FURNACE banner slab #t2-c10 (FIG ENRIGHT-HOUSE vignette, numeral fill 100%, bars HEARTH) + chainage stamp + Oswald meta + ember-deep drop-cap
p2c10.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark (Ember ◆ climax)
p2c10.notes: FIG ENRIGHT-HOUSE [0] 'THE ENRIGHT HOUSE WAS OPENED IN JUNE OF 1929' (7 hits). Opening + stolen photo [3] + fenced Temple plot [109]. HEARTH climax: first hearth. Solid Ember. Ember end mark. Num 170px.

p2c11.caption: STA T-XI · 7,773 words · FIG COSMO-SLOTNICK
p2c11.title: Chapter XI
p2c11.contentRationale: Mallory hired for the Temple figure; Dominique poses for the naked statue; walls rise behind the fence toward the sunset walk-through. Motif: standing figure on a modeling stand.
p2c11.openerComposition: FURNACE banner slab #t2-c11 (FIG COSMO-SLOTNICK vignette, numeral fill 35%, bars HIGHBARS) + chainage stamp + Oswald meta + ember-deep drop-cap
p2c11.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark
p2c11.notes: FIG COSMO-SLOTNICK [0] 'IN DECEMBER THE COSMO-SLOTNICK BUILDING WAS OPENED' (3 hits). Rival opening + Mallory hire [100] + posing [240] + sunset walk [260]. HIGHBARS = bromide mass under searchlight bands [ADOPTED reword; cornice 0 hits]. Fill 35% S. Num 120px.

p2c12.caption: STA T-XII · 9,005 words · FIG TEMPLE
p2c12.title: Chapter XII
p2c12.contentRationale: The cancelled opening, 'Sacrilege,' the trial, and Roark's entire defense: ten photographs in a brown envelope. Motif: envelope + fanned photographs.
p2c12.openerComposition: FURNACE banner slab #t2-c12 (FIG TEMPLE vignette, numeral fill 100%, bars HEARTH) + chainage stamp + Oswald meta + ember-deep drop-cap
p2c12.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark (Ember ◆ climax)
p2c12.notes: FIG TEMPLE [0] 'THE OPENING OF THE STODDARD TEMPLE WAS ANNOUNCED' (31 hits). Sacrilege [3] + trial + ten photos [196]. HEARTH climax. Temple MUST read horizontal/open ('wide open, like a western saloon' [9]), never pedimented. Solid Ember. Ember end mark. Num 120px.

p2c13.caption: STA T-XIII · 5,178 words · FIG VERDICT
p2c13.title: Chapter XIII
p2c13.contentRationale: The verdict, the printed testimony, the decoded cable, and Katie's question about the gates — ending in her defiance of Toohey. Motif: falling-open gates.

p2c13.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark

Lois Cook book [1] + rotogravure [4] + tea/napkin [80]. HIGHBARS = rhyme stave lines. COLD Bronze cap (quote-led, no-drop). Fill 20% S. Num 150px.

p2c6.readingTreatment: Shared calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark
